title: Watercolor "Blue Saffire" 289 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Located in the Park District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, amenities, nature trails, and dune lakes- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $40 per day**- Professionally decorated- Gourmet-style kitchen- 6 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Premium amenities meet great location! Located in WaterColor’s beautiful Park District, “Blue Saffire” features all of the amenities you love—and it’s just a short walk to the beach. Enjoy a morning hike along the nature trails that make their way through the shaded reaches of the resort. Later, a perfect day at the beach awaits, followed by an evening cooling off with loved ones around the private pool. Of course, all of the fun and excitement of Seaside are never far away.The first floor of this 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom retreat is home to four bedrooms. Entering through the front porch, guests will find a primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bath with a shower and tub. Adjacent are two guest bedrooms, both of which have king beds and private baths. The first floor also features an additional living space with two twin beds. A few steps away is another guest bathroom.The first floor offers access to the pool area, where you’ll find a handy beverage fridge—perfectly placed for evening cocktails—a grill and outdoor table seating. Sun worshipers will love the poolside chaise lounge chairs, while those who prefer shade will find it on the porch. Simply put, this is an outdoor space everyone will enjoy.The second floor is the heart and soul of this WaterColor retreat. Here you’ll find a gourmet kitchen with designer cabinets and select stainless appliances, including a Thermador freezer and a Jenn Air gas burner range. The counter has seating for 4, while the adjacent dining area offers seating for 10. The living room has a vast sectional sofa, a 50-inch flat-screen television. It accesses a vast porch with sweeping neighborhood views. The high ceilings, hardwood floors and abundant natural light complement the entire space.Just down the hall, you’ll find a primary bedroom with French doors opening onto a balcony. The bedroom offers a large walk-in closet and a private bathroom. Ascending to the third floor, you’ll find a loft-style guest bedroom with a full bed and 4 twin beds. The young at heart will be entertained for hours with the game table and flat-screen television.Blue Saffire is a professionally decorated getaway that sleeps 14. Six adult bikes allow guests to explore the resort’s extensive trail system, the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club, and the nearby communities of Seaside and Grayton Beach. Don’t miss your chance to unwind in one of WaterColor’s most popular districts. Book Blue Saffire today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Additional Living: Two Twin Beds- Guest Bathroom: Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Full Bed and Four Twin BedsUnfortunately, this home do

Ascending to the third floor, you’ll find a loft-style guest bedroom with a full bed and 4 twin beds. The young at heart will be entertained for hours with the game table and flat-screen television. Blue Saffire is a professionally decorated getaway that sleeps 14. Six adult bikes allow guests to explore the resort’s extensive trail system, the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club, and the nearby communities of Seaside and Grayton Beach. Don’t miss your chance to unwind in one of WaterColor’s most popular districts. Book Blue Saffire today!
